from pyscf import gto, dft

smi='O=C1NC2CC=CCC12'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=2025
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=20,params=params)
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
energies=[]
for cid in ids:

from rdkit import Chem

from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np
smi='O=C1NC2CC=CCC12'

params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=2025
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=20,params=params)
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
energies=[]
for cid in ids:
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props,confId=cid)
 ff.Minimize(maxIts=500)
 energies.append((ff.CalcEnergy(),cid))
energy,cid=min(energies)
conf=m.GetConformer(cid)
atoms=[(a.GetSymbol(),tuple(conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()))) for a in m.GetAtoms()]
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms,basis='6-31g(d)',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='b3lyp'; calc.conv_tol=1e-9
E=calc.kernel()
mo=np.array(calc.mo_energy); occ=np.array(calc.mo_occ)
homo_idx=np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]
print('SMILES',smi)
print('Formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
